blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sixty-six overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) and their families in Batangas received a total of P4.075 million in financial assistance, according to the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW). The assistance was distributed through the agency’s AKSYON Fund during the “Handog ng Pangulo: Serbisyong Sapat Para sa Lahat” event at the Batangas Provincial Capitol on Monday. Of the 66 beneficiaries, 46 received P50,000 each, nine received P75,000 each, and 11 received P100,000 each.
